case_title: Mohammad Wajid And Anr. v. State of U.P. And Ors.
neutral_facts: The case involves an FIR registered against six accused persons for alleged offenses under IPC Sections 395, 504, 506, and 323. The FIR alleges that the accused, who were involved in a land dispute, assaulted the complainant and his brother, forcibly took Rs. 2 lakh from the complainant's pocket, and threatened him. The FIR was registered in September 2022, over a year after the alleged incident in 2021. The complainant and his brother allegedly returned home silently after the incident due to fear. The High Court initially rejected the quashing of the FIR, but the Supreme Court quashed the FIR and criminal proceedings, finding the case to be fabricated and motivated by private grudge.
